title: DiceFrame character card body (schema 2)
description: The body a client puts in data.extensions.diceframe of a chara_card_v3 envelope. Only character_name and schema_version are required; every other field falls back to a server default. Server-only fields (id, card_id, provenance, source_plugin, plugin_content_id, raw_sillytavern, ruleset_revision, ruleset_operation_log, ruleset_runtime) are ignored on push.

effect.description: Stored as sent; only the first 500 characters are used in play.

portrait.description: {} for none, or {"kind": "builtin", "id": "..."}. upload/generated portraits refer to server-local assets and are dropped on push.

rule_binding.description: Present only on rules-aware (e.g. D&D 2024) cards; such cards are unsupported for push in v1.

ruleset_character.description: Rules-runtime authority of a rules-aware card; unsupported for push in v1.
